headline: Sensex Slips While Nifty Gains; Metals Shine Amid Global Cues
why: Metals and FMCG sectors saw strong buying interest
Falling crude oil prices improved market sentiment globally
Smallcap stocks witnessed a significant jump of 1.8 percent
Anticipation of US Federal Reserve upcoming policy decisions
whatHappening: Sensex closed 22 points lower while Nifty gained 53 points
Manipal Health cleared Rs 5,310 crore debt using IPO funds
ADIA arm plans a Rs 2,047-crore stake sale in Lenskart
Japanese Yen hit a two-week low after BOJ rate decision
summary: Indian markets ended mixed as Nifty crossed 23,200 while Sensex dipped slightly. Metal and FMCG sectors led the gains amid falling crude oil prices and smallcap strength. IT stocks remained under pressure ahead of the critical US Federal Reserve meeting.
